name: intraday-equities-predictive-program
date_semantics: Period start/end dates are inclusive exchange-local calendar dates. Fold validation is half-open [cutoff, cutoff + val_days); last_validation_end_exclusive is excluded.

development_validation.purpose: Disjoint rolling-origin outer validation for Gate 1, Gate 3, and model-zoo selection; reuse is declared development reuse, not independent confirmation.

final_fit_extension.purpose: Recent observations available to final-candidate fitting after architecture selection; no performance claim is made on this fit-only block.

final_hpo_embargo.purpose: One complete session between the fit cutoff and final HPO validation; longer than the maximum 60-minute label horizon.

final_hpo_validation.purpose: Finalist-only feature and hyperparameter selection. It is spent by selection and cannot be reported as untouched performance.

mean_confirmation_uncertainty_calibratio.purpose: Prospective confirmation of the already-frozen conditional-mean model and out-of-sample residual calibration for uncertainty sets. The same rows cannot evaluate the newly calibrated uncertainty product.

full_system_simulation.purpose: First untouched end-to-end simulation of frozen mean, uncertainty, Gate 2 capital control, MIO, costs, and execution rules; no retuning.

test_b.purpose: Predeclared August subperiod diagnostic inside the full-system simulation, never a second tuning set.

production.purpose: Earliest paper/live forward operation after the frozen bundle passes the full-system simulation and receives owner approval.

gate1_gate3.purpose: Select asset-local modelability horizons and audit each selection with whole-session null refits.

model_zoo.purpose: Compare candidate architectures on the same outer folds, with model-specific feature selection and HPO nested inside training.
model_zoo.evaluation_claim: Paired development comparison only; multiplicity-adjusted and not independent confirmation.

final_hpo.purpose: Tune only the predeclared finalist family, training through 2025-11-30 and validating on 2025-12-02 through 2026-02-28.
final_hpo.evaluation_claim: Selection only; the validation block is spent.

final_refit.purpose: Refit the frozen winner through 2026-02-28 without changing architecture, features, objective, or search space.

mean_confirmation_and_uncertainty_calibr.purpose: Confirm the frozen mean and then calibrate uncertainty from its genuinely out-of-sample residual vectors.
mean_confirmation_and_uncertainty_calibr.evaluation_claim: Untouched mean-model confirmation; calibration data, not evaluation data, for uncertainty.

full_system_simulation.purpose: Backtest the complete frozen forecast-to-MIO-to-execution path once, including Test B.
full_system_simulation.evaluation_claim: Untouched full-system simulation; any redesign creates a new prospective program.

production.purpose: Publish and operate the approved final MIO bundle prospectively.
